units.Description: V for SEEG, EEG and ECG: the release code reads the source EDFs with MNE (get_data, volts) and its PSD tables agree with the stored values in scale (per-participant median band-power ratio 0.0008-4.5 over ictal and interictal runs; µV would give about 1e12). MISC: n/a (not stated). The BrainVision headers keep 'unscaled', which readers apply as a factor of 1.

type.Description: SEEG for names 'POL <electrode letters><contact number>' (Nihon Kohden-style export names, kept verbatim) except 'POL Fp<n>'; EEG for 'EEG ...-Ref' and 'POL Fp<n>' (scalp electrodes); ECG for names containing ECG/EKG; MISC otherwise (e.g. 'POL E', 'POL A5A6-0', 'POL L', 'POL R'). Types are inferred from the names; the release does not list channel types.
